prompt: Draw a microservices architecture with an API Gateway connecting to Auth Service, User Service, and Order Service. Auth Service and User Service both connect to a PostgreSQL database. Order Service connects to Redis cache and MongoDB.

assertions.name: valid_json
assertions.description: Output file parses as valid JSON

assertions.name: valid_excalidraw_structure
assertions.description: Has type='excalidraw', version=2, and elements array

assertions.name: bidirectional_bindings
assertions.description: Every arrow binding has a matching boundElements entry on the target shape, and vice versa

assertions.name: all_services_present
assertions.description: Text elements mention all 7 nodes: API Gateway, Auth Service, User Service, Order Service, PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB

assertions.name: uses_color
assertions.description: At least 2 different non-transparent backgroundColor values are used across shape elements

assertions.name: has_arrows
assertions.description: Contains arrow elements connecting the services

assertions.name: no_overlapping_shapes
assertions.description: No two non-text shape elements occupy the exact same x,y position
